name: zagon
description: Your Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions on this machine: limits, live sessions, time and tokens per day, search over past sessions.
long_description: Runs `zagon mcp`, the MCP server of Zagon, over stdio. It reads the local Claude Code transcripts and Codex session files into its database in ~/.zagon and answers from there; nothing leaves the machine unless you connect Jira or notifications. Privacy: https://github.com/a1lezakty/zagon#privacy
